newsitem.title: USA: World Bank backs Haiti president, privatization.
newsitem.headline: World Bank backs Haiti president, privatization.

text.p: The World Bank on Thursday gave its support to Haiti President Rene Preval and defended his government's efforts to privatize the economy.
"There has been quite a lot of debate about the pace of development but I think we are now very satisfied with what the president is seeking to do," Bank president James Wolfensohn told reporters.
He added he hoped the economy, close to ruin after years of political chaos, would soon start to pick up.
"We have a very clear understanding of what President Preval wishes to do and we are going to back him."
Wolfensohn said there had been a lot of misinformation about the Bank's attempts to encourage foreign investment and privatisation.
It was essential to bring in the skills and financing to provide just the basic services.
"It's a practical step to try and alleviate a misery," he said.
